classification.difficultyReason: Ring area by subtraction or by π(R²−r²). Part c sets up and solves an equation for the inner radius.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of each ring between concentric circles.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Subtract the inner circle from the outer circle. Round your answer to 2 decimal places.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use $A=\pi(R^2-r^2)$. Round your answer to 2 decimal places.

children.label: c
children.prompt: The area of the ring is $75\pi\ \mathrm{cm}^2$. Find the inner radius $r$.
